title: The App
description: Twilightscapes for Apple TV, iPhone & iPad — an ambient night-photography app.

blocks.heading: Twilightscapes on Apple TV, iPhone & iPad
blocks.subheading: Turn your screen into a window onto the night — curated collections played fullscreen with slow crossfades and gentle drift.

blocks.body:
Twilightscapes is an ambient display app built around this photography. Pick a collection and let it play — no feeds, no noise, just night skies on the biggest screen in the house.

**On Apple TV** it's a living gallery: browse collections from the couch, swipe through photos with the Siri Remote, and let the Top Shelf surface featured work above the app icon.

**On iPhone and iPad** it doubles as a photo frame, and every photo can be saved as a wallpaper — vertical crops included. Saved photos are filed into a *Twilightscapes Downloads* album that syncs through iCloud Photos, so your favorites can even become your native Apple TV or Mac screensaver.

**Photo of the Day** picks one image from a rotating pool every day, and new collections arrive automatically from this site — no app update required. Everything is cached, so it all keeps working offline.

**Night School** rounds it out with short lessons on night photography — the exposure triangle after dark, long exposures, star trails versus the Milky Way — each with a field recipe you can take outside tonight.

items.question: Where do I get it?
items.answer: Twilightscapes is currently in App Store review. The download link will appear here the moment it goes live.

items.question: Which devices does it support?
items.answer: Apple TV (tvOS), iPhone and iPad, with an Apple Watch companion. A Mac app and screensaver are on the roadmap.

items.question: Do new photos really show up without an update?
items.answer: Yes — the app checks this site for new collections and lessons. Photos download once and are cached, so everything keeps working offline.

items.question: How do wallpaper downloads work?
items.answer: During playback, tap the download button to save the current photo to a Twilightscapes Downloads album in your Photos library. Vertical crops are saved when available, so wallpapers fit your phone.
